findings.title: Non-letter, non-digit, non-hyphen characters are retained
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 3: “Remove characters that are not letters, digits, or hyphens.”
findings.trigger: The title contains punctuation or another character outside letters, digits, hyphens, and whitespace; for example, "Hello, World!".
findings.consequence: The function returns an invalid slug; the required example returns "hello,-world!" instead of "hello-world".
findings.evidence: The return statement only applies `re.sub(r"\s+", "-", title.lower())`; it performs no substitution that removes disallowed characters.

reasoning: Lowercasing and whitespace replacement are implemented, but disallowed-character removal is absent. This directly defeats criterion 3 and the explicitly required example, meeting the stated blocker definition.
